pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Zawadi is a Kiswahili name. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. A mountain
   B. A road
   C. A gift
   D. A river

2. Which of these is part of the extended family? (1 mark)
   A. An uncle
   B. A bus driver
   C. A classmate
   D. A shopkeeper

3. What is the New Testament mainly about? (1 mark)
   A. The creation of the world only
   B. Jesus, His teaching and the early church
   C. The kings of Israel
   D. The Law of Moses only

4. In the reference John 3:16, what does the number 16 stand for? (1 mark)
   A. The chapter
   B. The page
   C. The verse
   D. The book

5. In which town did Zacchaeus live? (1 mark)
   A. Bethlehem
   B. Nazareth
   C. Jerusalem
   D. Jericho

6. Why did the donkey turn away from the road? (1 mark)
   A. She was hungry
   B. She was afraid of Balak
   C. She was tired
   D. She saw the angel and Balaam did not

7. Who had the dreams about seven cows and seven heads of grain? (1 mark)
   A. Joseph
   B. Pharaoh
   C. Potiphar
   D. Jacob

8. What does the word "annunciation" mean? (1 mark)
   A. An announcement
   B. A journey
   C. A festival
   D. A song

9. What was John's main work? (1 mark)
   A. Preparing the way for the Lord
   B. Leading an army
   C. Ruling Israel
   D. Building the temple

10. What did Bartimaeus do after he could see? (1 mark)
   A. He ran to the temple
   B. He followed Jesus
   C. He sold his cloak
   D. He went home to sleep

11. How did Jesus feel when He saw the widow? (1 mark)
   A. He was angry
   B. He was afraid
   C. He was bored
   D. His heart went out to her

12. Which verse says, "I am the resurrection and the life"? (1 mark)
   A. John 11:25
   B. Luke 7:14
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. Acts 2:38

13. If someone keeps hurting you even after you forgive, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Say nothing forever
   B. Tell a trusted adult
   C. Hit back
   D. Hurt them

14. Which is a good first step when you are angry with someone? (1 mark)
   A. Plan revenge
   B. Shout at the person
   C. Calm down and breathe
   D. Break their things

15. Which is the best way to give? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing
   B. Boasting
   C. Cheerfully and respectfully
   D. Grumbling

16. What does the parable teach about every person? (1 mark)
   A. Every person is precious to God
   B. Only adults matter
   C. Nobody matters
   D. Only rich people matter

17. What does the big tree stand for? (1 mark)
   A. A mountain
   B. A market
   C. The growth of God's kingdom
   D. A palace

18. Where is the parable of the mustard seed found in Luke? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Luke 15:8
   C. Luke 13:18-19
   D. Luke 1:37

19. What question did Nicodemus ask about being born again? (1 mark)
   A. Who are you?
   B. Where is Jerusalem?
   C. How can someone be born when old?
   D. Who is God?

20. What should you do with a borrowed book? (1 mark)
   A. Damage it
   B. Return it in good condition
   C. Sell it
   D. Keep it

21. What does it mean to glorify God with our bodies? (1 mark)
   A. To boast
   B. To hurt others
   C. To honour Him by how we use them
   D. To ignore Him

22. Which is an activity in church? (1 mark)
   A. Fighting
   B. Playing football inside
   C. Selling goods
   D. Praying and singing

23. Which disciple betrayed Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Thomas
   B. Andrew
   C. Peter
   D. Judas Iscariot

24. What came upon the disciples at Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. The Holy Spirit
   B. A storm only
   C. An army
   D. A king

25. Where is the Lord's Prayer found? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Acts 2:38
   C. John 3:16
   D. Matthew 6:9-13

26. Which fruit means being gentle and careful with people's feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Pride
   C. Gentleness
   D. Envy

27. Which fruit is shown by walking away instead of hitting back? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Self-control
   C. Pride
   D. Envy

28. Which verses in Galatians speak of self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Acts 2:1
   C. Luke 1:37
   D. Galatians 5:22-25

29. What is a good way to limit screen time? (1 mark)
   A. Skip meals
   B. Do your homework first and take breaks
   C. Watch all day
   D. Never sleep

30. What is social media? (1 mark)
   A. Websites and apps that let people share messages, pictures and videos
   B. A school
   C. A newspaper
   D. A market

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain the lessons that we learn from Matthew 21:12-14. (5 marks)

32. Why did King Balak ask Balaam for help? (2 marks)

33. Explain what "forgive" means. (2 marks)

34. Explain the two greatest commandments and how a child can obey them. (5 marks)

35. Explain how Jesus and Joseph are examples of forgiveness. (3 marks)

36. List three school rules and give a reason for each. (3 marks)

37. Describe three steps you can follow to forgive someone. (3 marks)

38. Explain how we can prevent the spread of contagious diseases and how we should treat those who are sick. (5 marks)

39. Describe how Stephen died. (3 marks)

40. Explain how the early church shows that God's kingdom grew from a small beginning. (5 marks)

41. Name the four Gospels and say what they tell us about. (4 marks)

42. Explain the meaning of the word disciple. (2 marks)

43. Why were people with leprosy kept apart in Bible times? (2 marks)

44. State two benefits of obeying parents. (2 marks)

45. Give two reasons why the birth of Jesus is unique. (2 marks)

46. Name two fruits of the Spirit and give an example of each. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — A gift
   Zawadi means a gift in Kiswahili.

2. A — An uncle
   Uncles are relatives outside the nuclear family.

3. B — Jesus, His teaching and the early church
   The New Testament tells about Jesus and the early church.

4. C — The verse
   In John 3:16, John is the book, 3 is the chapter, and 16 is the verse.

5. D — Jericho
   Luke 19:1 says Jesus was passing through Jericho.

6. D — She saw the angel and Balaam did not
   The donkey saw what Balaam could not see.

7. B — Pharaoh
   Genesis 41 says that Pharaoh had the dreams.

8. A — An announcement
   The annunciation is the announcement of Jesus' birth to Mary.

9. A — Preparing the way for the Lord
   Luke 1:76 says he would prepare the way.

10. B — He followed Jesus
   Mark 10:52 says he followed Jesus along the road.

11. D — His heart went out to her
   Luke 7:13 says He had compassion.

12. A — John 11:25
   John 11:25 records Jesus' words.

13. B — Tell a trusted adult
   Forgiveness does not mean staying in danger.

14. C — Calm down and breathe
   Calming down helps you to choose wisely.

15. C — Cheerfully and respectfully
   Kind giving respects the person.

16. A — Every person is precious to God
   God searches for each person.

17. C — The growth of God's kingdom
   The kingdom grows large.

18. C — Luke 13:18-19
   Luke 13:18-19 contains the parable.

19. C — How can someone be born when old?
   He was puzzled about a second birth.

20. B — Return it in good condition
   Borrowed items must be returned.

21. C — To honour Him by how we use them
   We honour God by how we live.

22. D — Praying and singing
   Worship includes prayer and singing.

23. D — Judas Iscariot
   Judas betrayed Jesus.

24. A — The Holy Spirit
   Acts 2 tells of the Holy Spirit.

25. D — Matthew 6:9-13
   Matthew 6:9-13.

26. C — Gentleness
   Gentleness is caring.

27. B — Self-control
   Self-control is controlling actions.

28. D — Galatians 5:22-25
   Galatians 5:22-25.

29. B — Do your homework first and take breaks
   Balance is important.

30. A — Websites and apps that let people share messages, pictures and videos
   Social media lets people connect.

SECTION B
----
31. (5 marks)
   Answer: The house of God is holy; it is for prayer; we must not misuse it or cheat others; Jesus cares about what happens there; it is a place of healing and help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson up to 5.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: He was afraid of the Israelites and wanted them to be cursed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fear and 1 mark for wanting the Israelites cursed.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: To stop being angry with someone and not pay them back for the wrong they did.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stopping anger and 1 for not paying back.

34. (5 marks)
   Answer: Love God with all your heart, soul and mind, and love your neighbour as yourself. A child obeys by praying, reading the Bible, going to church, and by kindness, sharing and forgiving others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for loving God, 1 for loving neighbour, 1 for prayer or Bible, 1 for kindness, 1 for forgiving or sharing.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus prayed for those who crucified Him. Joseph forgave his brothers and cared for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Jesus, 1 for Joseph, 1 for what each did.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Arrive on time, so lessons are not disturbed; keep quiet in class, so all can learn; do not fight, so all are safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule with a reason.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Calm down; think about what happened; talk to the person kindly; say I forgive you; pray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands with soap, keep the environment clean, eat well, visit the clinic and follow the advice of health workers. We should treat the sick with care, kindness and respect and not reject them, as Jesus did.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hygiene, 1 for clean environment, 1 for clinic advice, 1 for kindness, 1 for not rejecting the sick.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: The people were furious at his message, dragged him out of the city and stoned him. He prayed for God to receive his spirit and to forgive them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for anger, 1 for stoning, 1 for prayer.

40. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus began with a few disciples. On Pentecost about three thousand believed and were baptised. The church spread to many towns and countries, and today it is found in all the world including Kenya.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the few disciples, 1 for Pentecost, 1 for three thousand, 1 for spreading, 1 for today's church.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John. They tell about the life, teachings, death and resurrection of Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each Gospel named up to 3 marks, and 1 mark for what they tell about.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: A follower and learner of Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for follower and 1 for learner.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: The disease was contagious and people feared it would spread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for disease and 1 for fear of spread.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Pleases God, peace at home, trust from parents, learning good habits.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid benefit.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Conceived by the Holy Spirit, announced by an angel, He is the Son of God and Saviour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Love: sharing lunch; kindness: helping a friend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fruit with example.
